name: bom
description: Generate an AI-BOM (CycloneDX or SPDX) with agent-bom for this machine's agents and MCP servers, a project, a container image, a repository, or an AWS, Azure or GCP account - agents, MCP servers, tools, models and packages with their relationships and known vulnerabilities. Use when the user asks for an AI-BOM, agent BOM, SBOM, ML-BOM or an inventory file to share or attach.

findings.excerpt: - this machine's agents and MCP servers: `uvx --from agent-bom==0.113.2 agent-bom scan -q -f cyclonedx -o ai-bom.cdx.json`
- a project: add `-p '<dir>'`; a container image: `uvx --from agent-bom==0.113.2 agent-bom image '<ref>' -q -f cyclonedx -o image-ai-bom.cdx.json`
- a cloud account: `uvx --from 'agent-bom[aws]==0.113.2' agent-bom cloud aws --profile '<profile>' -f cyclonedx -o aws-ai-bom.cdx.json` (use `[azure]` with `clo
